observations: Gaming racing wheel with a yellow Ferrari shield logo in the center.
Two-pedal set on a textured plastic base.
PlayStation-style control buttons (D-pad, PS, Share, Options) integrated into the wheel.
Red 'Engine Start' button on the left side of the wheel hub.
Cables are visible connecting the components.
Watermark 'GAMESIMULATORHUB LTD.' appears on both images.

claims.evidence: The brand name 'Thrustmaster' and model 'T80' are not legible in the photos.
The Ferrari logo is clearly visible on the center of the wheel in photo 0 and photo 1.

risks.risk: The internal bungee cord centering mechanism may be worn or snapped.
risks.proof: A video showing the wheel being turned to full lock and released to confirm it returns to center.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken centering mechanism

risks.risk: The pedal sensors may be faulty, leading to incorrect or no input registration.
risks.proof: A video of the device connected to a console or PC showing the pedal input levels.

risks.risk: The fixed USB or pedal cables may have internal damage or frayed connections.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the cable entry points and the USB/RJ12 connectors.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's label on the underside of the wheel base to confirm the model.
Video of the wheel being turned and returning to center.
Video of the pedals being tested in a game or calibration menu.
response.reason: The specific model cannot be confirmed from the photos as the text is illegible. A photo of the identification sticker on the bottom is required to distinguish this from other Ferrari-branded wheels.
